item.title: Creepy Nuts become first to earn RIAA Gold for 2 Japanese songs, ‘Bling-Bang-Bang-Born’ & ‘Otonoke’
item.description: Creepy Nuts — the duo of three-time national rap battle champion R-Shitei and world champion DJ DJ Matsunaga — have become the first Japanese artists to receive RIAA Gold certifications for two Japanese-language songs. Their tracks ‘Bling-Bang-Bang-Born’ and ‘Otonoke’ have each surpassed 500,000 units in the U.S., earning official Gold status from the Recording Industry Association of America.
